gameDescriptionHtml:
“Pathogen X” is an atmospheric first-person survival horror game in which you have to take on the role of a BRCI special agent named Aiden Clark. He goes on a deadly mission to an underground laboratory to prevent a biological threat and retrieve a sample of Pathogen X.

Biological Threat: you will encounter various terrifying mutations caused by Pathogen X, and must fight for survival in a literally murderous environment where attacking mutants pose a constant threat to you.

Cooperation and guidance: During the mission, you will be assisted by Special Agent Maya Ackerman, who will be in touch with you via satellite channel to bring you up to speed and assist you in solving complex problems.

Horror atmosphere: the enveloping atmosphere and scenery emphasize the terrifying environment of the underground laboratory, where every step can be your last.

Weapons: Find and utilize all the weapons that the underground laboratory complex has to offer in your battle against the terrifying mutants.

Deadly and terrible enemies: in the game you will meet different types of enemies with unique features and abilities, from the simplest and stupid, to insanely strong and smart. Find the right approach to defeat them all.

Breathtaking graphics: The game offers stunning graphics that will immerse you in the gloomy world of the underground laboratory with amazing detail and realism.

Simple quest puzzles: to get through the complexities of the lab, you will have to act intuitively, shoot the lock? Or break the boards to open the passage? All this will add depth to the gameplay and increase the atmosphere of mystery.

Several endings and additional modes: “Pathogen X” offers several endings, your behavior and decisions affect which of them you will have, but it will not affect the final result. After passing, additional modes and quests will become available, expanding the game experience.

Music: in “Pathogen X” is dynamic and specifically designed for firefights. Energetic melodies raise the tension during intense battles and passing. The sounds of weapons and enemies merge with the music to create an exciting atmospheric soundtrack that emphasizes the game’s dynamism and action.
